data.name: Karkaba
data.detailed_description:
ENTER A FIGHTING GAME UNLIKE ANY OTHER

Karkaba brings the streets, folklore, rivalries, and humor of the Middle East into fast-paced competitive combat. Choose from a cast of unforgettable fighters, each with their own personality, fighting style, and special moves.

Battle across iconic arenas inspired by real locations, challenge friends on the same screen, or climb the online ranks with smooth rollback netcode. Every fight is packed with chaos, strategy, and unforgettable moments.

EASY TO PLAY. HARD TO MASTER.

Beneath the humor lies a surprisingly deep fighting system. Learn powerful combos, master special moves, read your opponent, and outplay them with timing, strategy, and skill.

Whether you're a casual player looking for chaos or a fighting game veteran chasing mastery, Karkaba rewards every match.

10 LEGENDS. 10 FIGHTING STYLES.

Meet a cast of unforgettable fighters inspired by Middle Eastern culture and folklore. Every character has their own personality, fighting style, strengths, weaknesses, and outrageous special attacks.

Find your favorite and make them your Karkaba champion.

FIGHT ACROSS THE ARAB WORLD

Throw hands beneath the neon lights of a Baghdad petrol station. Battle across Beirut rooftops. Clash among the ancient stones of Petra. Survive the chaos of a traditional wedding celebration.

Every stage is inspired by real locations, culture, and stories from across the Middle East.

KEY FEATURES:

●       10 Unforgettable Fighters: Inspired by Arab culture, folklore, and everyday life, each with unique moves, combos, and special attacks.

●       Battle Across 8 Unique Stages: Fight in iconic Middle Eastern locations packed with personality and surprises.

●       Online Multiplayer with Rollback Netcode: Enjoy smooth online matches and challenge players around the world.

●      Local Multiplayer Chaos: Settle rivalries with friends on the same screen and create unforgettable moments.

●      Deep Yet Accessible Combat: Easy to learn, rewarding to master, with combo routes, special moves, and advanced techniques.

●    A Fighting Game Unlike Any Other: Experience a cast, setting, and sense of humor rarely seen in the genre.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N.A.
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N.A.
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
